author: Rajesh K.
title: CARNAGE DELIVERED
body: Woody Harrelson was the highlight. Every scene he was in lifted the film.

author: Nurul H.
title: BETTER THAN THE FIRST
body: Tighter, funnier and the effects were a clear step up from the original.

author: Farid A.
title: GREAT NIGHT OUT
body: Went with friends and everyone enjoyed it. The banter between Eddie and Venom carries the whole thing.

author: Mei Ling C.
title: SOLID SEQUEL
body: Does exactly what it sets out to do. Not deep, but never boring.

author: Hafiz M.
title: TOM HARDY IS BRILLIANT
body: Playing both halves of that relationship is not easy and he makes it look effortless.

author: Priya S.
title: DECENT BUT SHORT
body: Enjoyable while it lasted, though at 1h37m it ends just as it gets going.

author: Zaid I.
title: LOVED THE 3D
body: Worth paying for the IMDb 3D screening, the action reads much better.

author: Siti N.
title: FUN THROUGHOUT
body: Leans into the comedy far more than the first film and is better for it.

author: Daniel L.
title: EXCELLENT VILLAIN
body: Cletus Kasady is genuinely unsettling and the final confrontation earns it.

author: Kavitha R.
title: MIXED FEELINGS
body: Strong opening and ending, but the middle section drags a little.

author: Amirul B.
title: GOOD POPCORN FILM
body: Exactly what you want on a Friday evening. No more, no less.

author: Jia Hui W.
title: WATCHED IT TWICE
body: Caught details the second time that I missed on the first viewing.

author: Syafiq O.
title: WORTH SEEING
body: Not a masterpiece but a genuinely entertaining hour and a half.

author: Ravi N.
title: AVERAGE STORY
body: The effects carry a fairly thin script, but the leads are watchable.

author: Lina A.
title: HUGELY ENJOYABLE
body: The chemistry between the two central characters is the whole appeal.

author: Haziq Z.
title: STRONG ACTION
body: The set pieces are well staged and easy to follow, which is rarer than it should be.

author: Yee Ling L.
title: OKAY OVERALL
body: Fine for a night out, though it does not really add anything new.

author: Faizal S.
title: EXPECTED MORE
body: The trailer promised a heavier film than the one that was delivered.
